question: Do explicit deterministic legal policies reproduce the analytical G0 terminal routes, and what interactions arise under an identity-independent one-ply area control?
controlled_factors: G0 rules, utility, board size, starting board, tie breaks and seed algorithm fixed; ordered script-policy pairing is the intervention. Identity directions only reinterpret outcomes because all three policies ignore identity.

policies.always_pass: Select pass on every nonterminal turn.
policies.one_stone_then_pass: At the first turn with any legal nonpass action, select the lowest row-major legal action; thereafter always pass, even if that stone is captured. If no nonpass is legal before placement, pass and keep placement pending. A fresh policy instance is created per game.
policies.greedy_area: Enumerate every legal action including pass, score its successor with G0 area scoring, maximize own-colour margin (black_score-white_score for black, negative for white), regardless of WIN/LOSE identity. On exact ties prefer pass, then lowest row-major action. No terminal bonus, depth beyond one, or random draw.

hypotheses.prediction: AlwaysPass/AlwaysPass ends after exactly two passes, black_score=0, white_score=2.5, winner=white.
Black OneStoneThenPass against white AlwaysPass ends in three moves; black_score=25, white_score=2.5, winner=black. All 25 isolated black placements followed by double pass have the same score.

Black AlwaysPass always has black_score=0 and loses against every legal white response under positive komi; script matrix plus randomized white fixtures exercise, but do not prove, the universal claim.
For each ordered policy pairing, actions and board outcome are identical across four identity directions, and utilities follow identity exactly.

sample.job_order: identity direction outer, black policy middle, white policy inner; policy order always_pass,one_stone_then_pass,greedy_area
sample.inference_unit: nine deterministic trajectories, not 36 independent stochastic replicates

engineering_fixtures.resume: interrupt after 5 games, resume with changed concurrency, byte-content comparison excluding game_wall_ms
engineering_fixtures.inference: Fixtures and regenerated games are verification only, excluded from research sample.

statistics: Exact descriptive counts and lengths only. No hypothesis p-values or confidence intervals for deterministic duplicated outcomes. No seed pooling claim.
expansion_rule: None. Complete fixed 36 cells once. If an analytical prediction or validation fails, stop, diagnose and create a new preregistered version before changing semantic definitions. Do not add stochastic evidence to this D0 table.
stop_conditions: any illegal action or full replay failure
repeated interruptions that prevent progress; checkpoint and sync before pausing
unpiloted computation projected substantially beyond overnight

execution.source_lock: all package Python plus run.py, with separate experiment lock for preregistration and thin CLI
execution.persistence: reuse atomic per-game RunStore, flush JSONL, full source/runtime resume checks; no claim of power-loss durability

decision_rule: If all D0 checks pass, recommend a separately preregistered small G0 MCTS D1 cost/direction pilot at64/256/1024 across >=3 batch seeds and four colour/identity directions; no D1 execution within D0. Retain7x7 NO-GO until Goal gates are met.
artifact_policy: Technical preregistration, reproducible code, tests, compact machine evidence and recoverable new run outputs may be synced on a new checkpoint branch. Stage narrative Markdown summaries remain outside the repository and go only to Google Drive. Never overwrite historical G0 outputs/reports; do not duplicate old generated data.
